subject: maths
question: Money is invested at 8%, 10% and 12% SI. Amount in third scheme is 200% of first and 150% of second. Total interest is ₹2800 in one year. Find investment in first scheme.
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest in first scheme = 8% SI

Rate of interest in second scheme = 10% SI

Rate of interest in third scheme = 12% SI

Time = 1 year

Total interest = ₹2800

Amount in third scheme = 200% of first

Amount in third scheme = 150% of second

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

Let investment in first scheme = x

Investment in third scheme = 200% of x

⇒ Third = 2x

Third = 150% of second

&a
